Watercool HEATKILLER S/G for Threadripper: This is a CG6 heat pipe kit/water block offered by Overclockers UK.
Full Nickel Threadripper CPU Watercooling Block: Complete Nickel water block.
During our testing, we will adhere to the standards set for our benchmarks by performing both procedures. For our comparisons, we will candidly assess and evaluate the quality and performance of our components without holding back.
The HEATKiller IV Pro has a cost significantly exceeding $20 and includes numerous fail-safes and performance-enhancing features. The price we saw represents the MSRP of the version sold without the base that secures the block. The base that attaches via safety feature bolts includes an additional part number for the HEATKILLER IV PRO. At the time of this review, it was still listed on the Watercool site, but I observed that it was out of stock at several vendors. Its price at Amazon, including free shipping, is $64.57 compared to the $149.57 MSRP from Watercool. The actual list price is much higher with some vendors. Overclockers UK lists it for £74.93 Including VAT (Over £100 in all, with shipping). In the UK, it does come with the base plate, and it does include a premium.
None of this review is complete without displaying the steps for installing the HEATKILLER IV Pro water block. As you can see from the video below, it really takes less than 3 minutes to install it.
I am very impressed with the Watercool HEATKILLER IV PRO water block for Threadripper. It is big, bold, and really stays true to the product's roots of craftsmanship and execution. Upon removing the cover from the block, one instantly sees the meticulous craftsmanship and attention to detail. The block is made of a solid block of copper that is something to behold, and their focus on the cooling of the heat sink package, which is housed inside of the block, is second to none
